span.p:
Redis pub/sub
Ravi doosre server pe
-> har doc ka channel (doc:123), jis server pe uska user wo SUBSCRIBE kare
server-1 publish -> Redis -> server-2 -> Ravi, OT owner hi karta
(pub/sub)
Ravi ka server restart -> channel se gaya, DB se le
pub/sub gira -> copy main bane, khoya nahi (replica)
